lessons.text: When a task's Done-when requires creating a specific documentation file, verify the file exists on disk before marking the task complete — a commit message deferring the content is not a substitute for a follow-up commit that actually creates it.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a spec s independent test names a specific verification scenario write a test for that exact scenario rather than a weaker proxy assertion e g checking static css class names and then marking the criterion done
lessons.text: When a spec's Independent Test names a specific verification scenario, write a test for that exact scenario rather than a weaker proxy assertion (e.g. checking static CSS class names) and then marking the criterion done.

lessons.key: spec_deviation::when a left to right scanning helper tracks an expect start boundary add an explicit test for the case where the scanned token is the very last character e g a trailing operator that zero length remainder boundary is where off by one bugs hide
lessons.text: When a left-to-right scanning helper tracks an 'expect start' boundary, add an explicit test for the case where the scanned token is the very last character (e.g. a trailing operator) — that zero-length-remainder boundary is where off-by-one bugs hide.
